infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AIWardrobe uses the camera to photograph clothing items you choose to add to your wardrobe and to capture outfit photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AIWardrobe accesses the photo library only to import clothing images you select and to save or share outfit photos you create.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: AIWardrobe saves outfit photos you create to your photo library when you choose to share or export them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your current location is used once per session to fetch local weather so AIWardrobe can suggest weather-appropriate outfits. Location is not stored or shared.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AIWardrobe uses the microphone only while recording a wardrobe video you choose to capture.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your data is used to deliver personalized ads and measure their effectiveness.
